mode: server-death
detection: watchdog 60s probe (2 fails)
selfHeal: evogent-boot.sh restart

mode: scheduler-death / cycle-stall
detection: watchdog cycle-liveness (stamp >8h)
selfHeal: restart evo-sched + notify card

mode: source-barren (parser rot / app UI drift)
detection: harvest_watch streak + verify-intents sources-flowing (trailing norm) + audit flow step
selfHeal: diagnosis agent adapts instruction files; code changes via suggestion card

mode: judgment-file corruption (account-tiers etc)
detection: verify-intents datafile-* checks
selfHeal: none (loud FAIL; graceful degradation meanwhile)

mode: a11y service revoked (APK reinstall, system)
detection: a11y-check probe
selfHeal: a11y-heal per cycle + boot

mode: execute-action result lost
detection: audit stale-dispatched check; card shows Working state
selfHeal: dedicated session + result POST to card

mode: curator ships zero / pool filtering
detection: taste-ranked-top10 + shipped-count in cycle log + audit
selfHeal: hard-invariants block; floor keeps feed alive

mode: curator session poisoning
detection: decline-everything pattern
selfHeal: ephemeral curator per cycle

mode: memory-pressure OOM during curation
detection: free -m preflight
selfHeal: skip brain curation; floor carries; orphan reaping

mode: staged-build-undeployed
detection: watchdog deploy-guard (tar newer than BUILD_ID)
selfHeal: auto-deploy when idle

mode: trust-gate loopback 403 (writes lost)
detection: e2e loopback write test; zero-interactions anomaly
selfHeal: none (fixed in code; audit watches feedback health)

mode: tap-through dead end (no url / wrong url)
detection: validators (permalinks, IG author-url); url-fallback in mapper
selfHeal: validators repoint/strip per cycle

mode: shizuku down after reboot
detection: cycle 3-probe check
selfHeal: user card (needs one tap in Shizuku app)

mode: probe self-match (pgrep finds its own ssh)
detection: bracket-pattern convention [x]
selfHeal: n/a (convention)

mode: lone-watchdog SPOF (supervisor dies, nothing revives it)
detection: scheduler ensure_watchdog (each loop) + watchdog cycle-liveness (mutual)
selfHeal: cross-supervision: scheduler(in tmux) and watchdog(setsid outside tmux) each restart the other; both must die simultaneously to stay dead; APK BootReceiver covers full reboot

mode: wrong-but-nonzero harvest (UI update, content fields stale)
detection: (forecast)
selfHeal: (planned)
gap: per-source engagement/dup ratio anomaly vs trailing baseline; not yet instrumented

mode: notification-listener revoked (Gmail signal dark)
detection: (forecast)
selfHeal: (planned)
gap: add notif-listener probe beside a11y-check; heal like a11y

mode: curator quality drift (all invariants pass)
detection: (forecast)
selfHeal: (planned)
gap: rolling baseline on thumbs-down rate + dwell; trend not point-in-time

mode: logged-out session scraped as content
detection: (forecast)
selfHeal: (planned)
gap: per-source login-wall detector: near-identical boilerplate across many items = 0 usable

mode: SQLite corruption (power loss mid-write)
detection: (forecast)
selfHeal: (planned)
gap: PRAGMA quick_check on boot; restore from data/backups on malformed

mode: storage full (silent write block)
detection: (forecast)
selfHeal: (planned)
gap: df check in watchdog probe; card <500MB; prune tmp/logs

mode: clock skew (RTC reset/DST)
detection: (forecast)
selfHeal: (planned)
gap: sanity-check clock vs server-issued time before trusting wall-clock staleness

mode: battery/doze throttles cycle beyond watchdog reach
detection: (forecast)
selfHeal: (planned)
gap: cycle-liveness catches full stall; gradual slowdown not; log cadence trend

mode: codex CLI self-update changes schema/auth
detection: (forecast)
selfHeal: (planned)
gap: log codex version each cycle; parse-failure spike alarm

mode: prompt-file truncation (markdown, no checksum)
detection: verify-intents promptfile-* (live < 1/3 of .default size)
selfHeal: (alarm only; restore from .default or git)
gap: min-length/section-marker sanity check on curation-prompt/rubric like the JSON datafile checks

mode: tmux server-wide crash (all sessions at once)
detection: (forecast)
selfHeal: (planned)
gap: watchdog checks session not server; distinguish dead-server from dead-session in diagnosis

mode: two-agent DB write race (SQLITE_BUSY / --resume same thread)
detection: (forecast)
selfHeal: (planned)
gap: cycle lock exists; ensure WAL + busy_timeout; never concurrent --resume on one thread id

mode: script-copy-drift (cycle runs a stale copy of a dev-edited script)
detection: harvest_watch on ALL sources incl recipe loop; a feature that never runs shows as flat/zero yield
selfHeal: symlink phone-sources recipes to canonical phone-tools scripts (single source of truth)
gap: source-scout copies scripts into phone-sources; audit should diff copies vs canonical

mode: cycle-step invocation typo/missing (step silently no-ops)
detection: cycle-steps-exist
selfHeal: (none)
gap: verify-intents cycle-steps-exist parses the cycle's invocations + checks each exists non-empty (catches tweet-clean vs tweet_clean, stale symlinks)

mode: source-branch feature-parity gap (field wired on one source, dropped on another)
detection: (none)
selfHeal: (none)
gap: no general check; each instance (IG mediaUrls, published_at_ms) found ad-hoc — candidate for a cross-branch schema assertion

mode: hardcoded personal-instance data in product code (system user, owner handle, personal name)
detection: (none)
selfHeal: (none)
gap: Add a recurring public-boundary guard for hardcoded deployment-specific data.

mode: test fixtures leak into real feed
detection: (none)
selfHeal: (none)
gap: convention only ([TEST] marker + same-session cleanup); no detector — daily audit could scan for fabricated-looking life-admin

mode: concurrent deployment leaves an incomplete runtime artifact
detection: serialized release transaction verifies the staged artifact, release marker, and post-swap health
selfHeal: reject incomplete staging and restore the last verified release
gap: Exercise concurrent deployment and rollback paths in release tests.

mode: judge-not-through-user-lens (audits/checks read raw table, user sees filtered view)
detection: verify-intents user-lens + barren-counter sanity vs per-source 24h counts
selfHeal: fixed in code
gap: Keep every judge on display-equivalent filters or the public API, with observer-parity tests.

mode: saturating yield counter (count via capped endpoint reads zero-gain forever)
detection: verify-intents user-lens + barren-counter sanity vs per-source 24h counts
selfHeal: fixed in code
gap: src_count now COUNT(*) at the store; lesson: never measure flow through a limited view

mode: OS display policy prevents an app from rendering on the hidden display
detection: capability, accessibility-root, and nonblank-frame probes distinguish rendering failure from source barrenness
selfHeal: apply the documented supported display configuration or surface a recovery action
gap: Exercise hidden-display rendering end to end after setup and OS updates.

mode: captured media is attributed by tap sequence instead of visible source identity
detection: per-run frame identity plus visible account-boundary checks let the runtime judge reject interstitial, stuck, or auto-advanced content
selfHeal: unbound frames never ship and validators quarantine invalid media references
gap: Keep source-identity binding in end-to-end media-capture drills.

mode: drill-sequencing contamination (drills kill both supervisors without restoration between)
detection: chaos runbook rule: restore full stack state between dependent drills; final-state check at end of every drill run
selfHeal: (runbook discipline)
gap: chaos-drill.md updated expectation: verify stack green between drills

mode: DB write-lock contention (8s BEGIN IMMEDIATE)
detection: feed API stays 200 under lock (busy_timeout)
selfHeal: sqlite busy_timeout absorbs

mode: installer selects a stale artifact from a sibling build tree
detection: build output names and validates one canonical signed artifact path
selfHeal: install tooling accepts only the artifact produced by the current verified build
gap: Refuse artifacts older than or unrelated to the newest canonical build.

mode: lock fd inherited by spawned daemon (deploy flock held by the production server it restarted)
detection: flock -w 300 fails LOUDLY naming the likely cause; deploy.log 'waiting' pile-up
selfHeal: spawn daemons with 9>&-; nothing runs after deploy-done; kill-by-pid + rm lockfile unblocks
gap: generalize: audit other flock users (cycle lock) for daemon-spawn fd leaks

mode: a code-level break is detected but has no bounded repair path
detection: flow tripwires and diagnosis agents persist a host-reviewable development suggestion
selfHeal: host development implements, releases, and verifies code changes while the phone retains safe runtime fallbacks
gap: Measure suggestion-to-verified-release recovery without granting the phone source-write authority.

mode: accidental detail open becomes learned preference
detection: engagement and preference-context tests distinguish restored depth, rapid taps, deliberate scroll, and sustained dwell
selfHeal: preference projection ignores weak sessions while retaining raw private evidence

mode: bench row disappears or blocks refresh before durable feed write
detection: refresh tests distinguish durable acknowledgement, attributable permanent rejection, and unattributed retry
selfHeal: peek is non-consuming; durable rows are acknowledged, permanent item errors retain quarantine receipts, and unattributed failures remain active

mode: concurrent feed mutation applies a stale snapshot
detection: serialized submit-arrange-refresh tests
selfHeal: reentrant process-wide feed mutation lock

mode: trusted loopback process serves an unusable main-frame HTTP error
detection: native main-frame HTTP status policy plus physical broken-server drill
selfHeal: WebView remains hidden behind native Error, Retry, and apps escape while authenticated reload retries

mode: Android Back appends history or exits launcher root
detection: host/page tests plus physical A-to-B-to-Back and root-Back drill
selfHeal: reauthenticate then call WebView history traversal; root Back is a no-op; one press queues during an in-flight proof

mode: HOME gesture forgets or overwrites the user's last explicit home surface
detection: pure MAIN+LAUNCHER versus MAIN+HOME policy tests plus physical launch-app-then-HOME drills from both surfaces
selfHeal: only explicit surface controls mutate the private preference; malformed intents remain in Evogent

mode: remembered stock HOME component is missing or no longer launchable
detection: stock-component resolution failure and host policy test
selfHeal: clear the stale stock choice and continue in the role-holding Evogent HOME instead of retrying a redirect loop

mode: assistant role is lost after install or OS update
detection: verify-intents checks the Android ASSISTANT role holder
selfHeal: release verification restores the intended role through the existing privileged setup boundary; the APK never silently seizes a user-selected role

mode: assistant screen context survives its explicit invocation or includes password/screenshot data
detection: one-shot bounded context tests, packaged assistant contract checks, and runtime artifact inspection
selfHeal: keep only a random-token RAM handoff, filter password inputs, disable screenshots and lock-screen launch, consume once, and expire abandoned entries

mode: persistent Evogent cross-app overlay capability is reintroduced
detection: APK build rejects overlay services, special-use overlay foreground service, and SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW
selfHeal: system assistant role owns anywhere Add Message; ordinary launcher icons own surface switching

mode: a stale notification receipt cancels a newer post that reused the same Android key
detection: native policy tests bind package, opaque key, post time, and content generation, then re-read the active notification before cancellation
selfHeal: receipt mismatch or changed active generation preserves the current original
gap: Repeat rapid same-key replacement at the physical notification shade after Android updates

mode: Evogent suppresses an original when its replacement digest is unavailable
detection: tests cover unavailable server, failed persistence, denied posting permission, disabled channel, digest publication timeout, and queue overload
selfHeal: suppression requires exact persistence plus an active digest; every failed prerequisite preserves the original
gap: Exercise permission and channel revocation at the glass

mode: secret notification content crosses the native-to-server boundary or enters public diagnostics
detection: native redaction tests, server defense-in-depth tests, local-data hygiene checks, and content-free Android logging
selfHeal: strip secret/safety fields before request construction and store a generic protected notice
gap: Extend phrase coverage only from generalized secret classes, never from committed private examples

mode: notification-listener capability is described as full lock-screen control
detection: public architecture and UI explicitly enumerate Android-owned lock-screen, call, alarm, media, authentication, emergency, and System UI surfaces
selfHeal: fall back to Observe and report the exact unsupported surface instead of implying interception
gap: Re-audit authority after target-SDK or Android platform changes

mode: every configured source is browsed on every curation cycle
detection: structured cycle outcomes compare due/signalled sources with actual browse starts
selfHeal: private per-source cadence skips unrelated work; source-specific notifications override only their matching source
gap: Observe due/skip behavior across a full natural cadence window after source changes

mode: a model benchmark scores a hidden-display timeout or phone-driver failure as poor model judgment
detection: benchmark receipts carry separate mechanicsStatus and qualityStatus; any mechanics-failed pair invalidates qualification
selfHeal: quality remains not_scored and the prior proven route stays active
gap: Repeat representative paired suites after Android, source-app, provider, or phone-mechanics changes

mode: a cheaper routine model remains active after its evidence expires or its workload changes
detection: route resolution verifies recent paired receipts on every cycle
selfHeal: insufficient, expired, malformed, or mechanics-contaminated proof falls back to the configured baseline
gap: Natural-run review must still judge editorial quality after every route promotion

mode: daily overseer, reflection, and dream all review the same evidence
detection: scheduler durable-task tests and per-service-day terminal receipts
selfHeal: one bounded overseer replaces overlapping broad daily reviews
gap: Verify exactly one natural cross-cycle review after migration

mode: notification delivery waits for or sends content through a model
detection: notification integration tests and model-routing policy assert deterministic execution
selfHeal: model/provider availability cannot block local capture, redaction, persistence, or digest publication
gap: Exercise notifications with the provider offline and under deep Doze

mode: a dismissed or Android-removed notification is recreated by a delayed request or another event in its deduplication bucket
detection: server tests race exact removal tombstones against ingest and replay a dismissed dedupe bucket; native queue tests retire in-flight, live, and historical revisions
selfHeal: persist the content-free exact tombstone before acknowledgement, reject receipt minting for tombstoned or dismissed buckets, and preserve every late Android original
gap: Repeat removal-during-ingest and user dismissal with generic fixtures at the physical shade

mode: the aggregate digest alerts twice, opens the wrong surface, or retains coverage for a withdrawn event
detection: native contract tests require the silent low-importance channel, bounded exact coverage markers, Notifications-view intent, and lifecycle shrink or retraction
selfHeal: publish one non-auto-cancel aggregate, remove exact external or user-resolved coverage, retract when empty, and refresh deterministic rich ranking on the next ingest
gap: Verify locked and unlocked digest behavior, tap routing, and partial/empty coverage at the glass

mode: the private phone server is unavailable while Evogent is the remembered HOME surface
detection: every system-HOME invocation requires a fresh process-bound loopback proof and an exact-once bounded availability token
selfHeal: request the durable runtime repair path and open stock HOME for that invocation without changing the user's explicit surface choice; explicit Evogent launches retain native Retry and Android Home controls
gap: Repeat healthy-to-dead, cold-boot, hung-authentication, stale-callback, and repair-return journeys at the glass

mode: Android or Play Protect opens a foreground scan or install confirmation while a release transaction is in flight
detection: separate package-manager completion from a typed foreground user_action_required state, then re-read exact installed APK identity and the durable transaction phase
selfHeal: keep the candidate and journal durable during the bounded foreground wait, surface the required platform action without exporting screen content, and continue idempotently after fresh Android proof; timeout, process interruption, explicit refusal, or a security block fails closed to a proven predecessor before retry
gap: Exercise first install, update, accepted scan, refusal, timeout, process death, reboot, and retry on physical stock Android

mode: a terminal rolled-back release transaction continues to gate scheduler or hidden-display work
detection: the durable rollback decision exists while its exact predecessor is healthy but the transaction journal or control-plane gate remains
selfHeal: hold the exclusive install lease through predecessor boot, exact control-plane proof, journal retirement, dependency cleanup, and final lease release so no observer can inherit a half-rearmed rollback
gap: Exercise rollback, owner death, package-replaced receiver, concurrent boot recovery, and exact post-rearm journal retirement on a physical phone

mode: a source repeatedly fails before publishing a trustworthy browse receipt but never enters the barren-content tripwire
detection: maintain a separate crash-safe per-source incident lane for exact mechanics_failure and mechanics_no_receipt outcomes without incrementing proved-empty state
selfHeal: after the repeated-failure threshold, keep one truthful warning visible and claim at most one shared automatic diagnosis per service day; clear the mechanics incident only after a fresh, deduplicated, or proved-empty completion receipt
gap: Exercise repeated failure, missing receipt, daily-budget contention, owner death, healthy recovery, and independence from barren counters on the physical scheduler
